steps.note: Start the single-stage auction creation flow.
Configure the auction with traffic-light conditions and explicit lower and upper bounds.
Apply the auction pricing template before adding items.
Add a line item for vendor bidding.
Invite the product's available QA vendors.
Confirm the auction reached a published live event page.
Submit a vendor bid inside the configured traffic-light range.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Submit a second vendor bid outside the configured range to provide contrasting response conditions.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's auction responses view.
Verify that both submitted vendor responses are visible to the buyer.
Confirm the responses screen has no rendering errors or invalid values.
